faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Can I change plans at any time?
faq.a1: Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes will affect your next billing cycle.
faq.q2: What happens if I cancel my subscription?
faq.a2: Your data is always yours. If you cancel, you'll retain access until the end of your billing period, and your data will be safely stored if you decide to return.
faq.a3: The BASICO plan gives you access to core features to get started. You can upgrade anytime as your needs grow.
